facets.finding: Talent.onAttackProc: first surprise hit adds random 1-2 damage at rank 1 or 2 at rank 2; per-enemy tracker prevents repetition.
While invisible, accumulates 0.5 * rank shield per update, capped at 1 + 2 * rank (3/5); a stronger existing Barrier is retained.
Scroll path offers factor * (1 + 2 * rank) invisibility, giving factors 3/5 at ranks 1/2.
Search radius increases by one; rank 1 uses rounded search and rank 2 square search.
Sleeping enemy wake check is prevented at distance >= 4 - rank: 3 tiles at rank 1, nonadjacent at rank 2.
Artifact-use handler prolongs the boost by 3 * rank turns: 3/6/9.
Unequipped cloak charging factor is 0.75 * rank / 3: 25/50/75%; alternate Ring of Energy multiplier adds 0.2 * rank / 3, matching rounded 7/13/20% text.
Strictly below the rank/preparation threshold is correct: rank 1 4/13/27/67%, rank 2 5/17/33/83%, rank 3 6/20/40/100%; bosses use one fifth of those thresholds.
Stored blink ranges match ordinary text: 1/3/4/6, 2/4/6/8, 2/5/7/10 tiles.

Demonstrated ordinary-description omission: +2 invisible stacks require inactive freerunning and no remaining cooldown and cap at 10. Rank 2 pauses active freerunning while invisible; rank 3 supplies 2x speed outside freerunning.
Lifetime berry allowance is 2 + 2 * rank minus berries already dropped: 4/6.
Trigger cooldown is 15 - 5 * rank: 10/5. Regeneration-disabled or accumulated furrow counter >= 200 produces furrowed grass; otherwise counter increases by 3 - rank.
Mind-vision enemy distance is 1 + rank: 2/3 tiles; neutral stealthy mimics and objects are excluded.
Expected durability uses multiply by 1.25 + 0.25 * rank: 1.5/1.75 before later durability rounding.
Actual adjacent accuracy factor is 0.5 + 0.25 * rank: 0.75/1/1.25; nonadjacent factor is 1.5.
5/10/15-turn reveal and 20-turn cooldown match formulas, but the alternate thrown-weapon creation path omitted the existing branch field. Real branch-1 FOV failure reproduced separately.
Tipped-dart durability usage divides by 1 + rank, giving 2x/3x/4x before expected-use rounding.
Waiting records position; movement removes the tracker; the next qualifying non-thrown strike adds random rank..2 damage and consumes it.
Weapon ability grants the existing tracker with hero cooldown + 4; qualifying next melee accuracy factors are 2/5/infinite at ranks 1/2/3.

Each eligible equipped armor/melee item contributes 0.5/0.75/1 energy by tier 3/2/1 and learned rank; unarmed or active Ring of Force excludes the weapon contribution. Rank 3 grants cloth armor and gloves.
Energy ability threshold is 5 - rank: 4/3/2. Either pairing order within the existing 5-turn tracker refunds one energy, capped at capacity.
